Candy.merchantPre: This is a peppermint candy for {{player}}. It's a delicious treat! {{count}} candies and it's theirs!
Candy.sorceressPre: This is a pineapple candy. I dropped it while I was brewing, and it turns out I don't need it any more. {{player}} can have it for {{count}} lollipops.
Candy.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! I was going to eat this candy but as a reward, {{player}} can have it.
Candy.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar, and I made... a chocolate candy! Just for {{player}}! I hope they enjoy it!
Candy.forgePost: I always keep a jar of candy around. You never know when you're going to need one!
Candy.sorceressPost: You know, there was once a time I gave someone a candy and they popped it straight into their mouth and choked on it. Please don't be that person.

Lollipop.merchantPre: This is a lemon-flavoured lollipop. My favourite! It costs {{count}} candies to send - shipping and all!
Lollipop.sorceressPre: This is a pumpkin-flavoured lollipop. It's a byproduct of a potion I was trying to brew earlier, and I don't need it any more. {{player}} can have it for {{count}} lollipops.
Lollipop.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! I was going to eat this lollipop but as a reward, {{player}} can have it.
Lollipop.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar, and I made... a chocolate-flavoured lollipop! Just for {{player}}! I hope they enjoy it!
Lollipop.sorceressPost: I don't really like the pumpkin flavoured ones anyway.
Lollipop.forgePost: This lollipop is delicious! It will be very useful to {{player}}.

Chocolate Bar.merchantPre: This is a chocolate bar. I don't know what it is used for, but it happens to be quite rare, which explains the price. {{count}} candies to ship it straight to {{player}}!
Chocolate Bar.sorceressPre: This is a chocolate bar. Legend has it that there is a wishing well somewhere that will enchant your gear, if you throw a chocolate bar in. But that's just a legend. Right?
Chocolate Bar.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! I was going to eat this chocolate bar but as a reward, {{player}} can have it.
Chocolate Bar.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar. I used the candies to open a portal to {{player}}'s world - and sent them the chocolate bar! I hope they enjoy it!
Chocolate Bar.forgePost: My son is a chocolatier! I get these chocolate bars from him for cheap.
Chocolate Bar.sorceressPost: I'm sure it's just a legend. I'm the No. 1 sorceress in these lands anyway!

HP Bar.merchantPre: The numbers on this thing keep going up and down, but I don't know what they mean. Do you know what they mean?
HP Bar.sorceressPre: That's a device for measuring {{player}}'s life force. I made it myself, which wasn't easy. {{count}} lollipops and I'll send it to them.
HP Bar.sorceressPost: Thank you so much! I knew this device would be popular! I should make more of them.
HP Bar.forgePost: It took me a lot of time to create this device. I guarantee that {{player}} will appreciate its functionality.
HP Bar.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test. As a reward, I've sent a {{item}} to {{player}}. I'm sure they'll appreciate being able to keep an eye on their HP.
HP Bar.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar and I made... a device for telling you how many injuries {{player}} has sustained! I hope they find it useful!

Time Ring.merchantPre: This is a time ring. It's kind of magical. It allows {{player}} to slow down the time when they're in trouble.
Time Ring.sorceressPre: That's a ring imbued with the power to slow time itself. If things are happening too fast, one rub on the ring by {{player}} will instantly slow down the time, giving them room to breathe.
Time Ring.sorceressPost: Thanks for buying! Don't worry, the time slowing only affects their world.
Time Ring.forgePost: Tell {{player}} to treat this ring very carefully. The sorceress has imbued it with strange magic.
Time Ring.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! I promised {{player}} that if you could solve my puzzle, I would give him my ring. I guess I need to uphold my end of the deal now.
Time Ring.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar and made... a golden ring! Do you think {{player}} would find it useful?

Candy Merchant's Hat.merchantPre: I could sell my hat, but it is very precious. Very precious indeed.
Candy Merchant's Hat.sorceressPre: I found this worn-out hat sitting on the bridge the other day, when I was going for my daily flight. {{count}} lollipops, and it's yours!
Candy Merchant's Hat.sorceressPost: Thanks! That hat had a slight touch of magic, but I couldn't figure out what it was. Maybe {{player}} could tell you once they find out?
Candy Merchant's Hat.forgePost: I hope {{player}} will like this hat. I've repaired it and made it brand new!
Candy Merchant's Hat.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! While you were doing that, I dropped this hat I found in the sea. It seems to have made its way to {{player}}.
Candy Merchant's Hat.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies to create some straw and bound it together into this really nice hat using the chocolate! I hope {{player}} likes it!

Leather Gloves.merchantPre: These leather gloves are made from camel leather, this is high quality. Only {{count}} candies!
Leather Gloves.sorceressPre: These leather gloves are nothing special. No magic in them whatsoever. They will keep your hands warm though.
Leather Gloves.forgePost: Thanks for the candies! I fixed up these gloves I had when I was a child. {{player}} can have them.
Leather Gloves.sorceressPost: Alternatively, if you want warmth, I can spawn fireballs for you. Just say the word.

Leather Boots.merchantPre: These high quality leather boots, made from camel leather, will keep your feet warm.
Leather Boots.sorceressPre: These leather boots are nothing special. No magic in them whatsoever. They will keep your feet warm though.
Leather Boots.forgePost: Thanks for the candies! I made a new pair of boots for myself and {{player}} can have my old ones.
Leather Boots.sorceressPost: Alternatively, if you want warmth, I can spawn fireballs for you. Just say the word.

Progressive World Map.merchantPre: This seems like a map, although I'm not sure what exactly is on it. Maybe you know?
Progressive World Map.sorceressPre: This is a map from {{player}}'s world. If you buy it and send it to them, they can explore more of their world. Only {{count}} lollipops - what a steal!
Progressive World Map.sorceressPost: Thanks a lot! The map will be very useful for {{player}}.
Progressive World Map.forgePost: Thanks! A cartographer from {{player}}'s world sent me this map, but it was torn. I've fixed it now.
Progressive World Map.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! I sent {{player}} a bit of information on what's beyond their horizons.
Progressive World Map.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar and made... a map! Of what, you say? {{player}}'s world of course!

Troll's Bludgeon.merchantPre: This weapon is an artifact passed down through many generations of my family. It used to belong to a troll, but my grandfather's grandfather's father won it from them in a legendary game of Mahjong.
Troll's Bludgeon.sorceressPre: I stole this from the troll on the bridge outside years ago. He doesn't know that I have it. I think he has a new one now, though, so {{player}} can have this one... for {{count}} lollipops of course!
Troll's Bludgeon.sorceressPost: Whatever you do, don't tell the troll. It would be unfortunate for you if the troll found out.
Troll's Bludgeon.forgePost: A troll taught me how to build these many years ago, but I never understood the language of trolls.
Troll's Bludgeon.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! A friendly troll gave me this and told me to pass it on to someone who really needs it, so {{player}} can have it.
Troll's Bludgeon.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar. The dragon came back yesterday with this, I think {{player}} would really like it.

Desert bird feather.sorceressPost: Delivered! I didn't charge you shipping because the feather is almost weightless!
Desert bird feather.merchantPre: I went hunting in the Desert, and found this feather the other day! I've been feeling quite jumpy ever since, and honestly, I don't like it! {{count}} candies and it can be {{player}}'s.
Desert bird feather.sorceressPre: This feather straight from the Candian Desert is imbued with magical properties! Some say it's like being on the moon! For {{count}} lollipops, I'll mail it to {{player}}.
Desert bird feather.forgePost: A bunch of desert birds came around the other day and I found this feather sitting outside. I know it will be useful!
Desert bird feather.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! One of the birds from the desert flew into the lighthouse the other day and lost some feathers. {{player}} can have one of them - it'll help them jump higher!
Desert bird feather.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I took 100 candies and a chocolate bar! I found a feather in the chocolate bar you gave me, so I used the candies to open a portal to {{player}}'s world and I gave them the feather!

Beginners' Grimoire.merchantPre: I found this book in the basement the other day. I don't know how to read the language, but it looks useful, so I can send it to {{player}} for {{count}} candies.
Beginners' Grimoire.sorceressPre: This is a grimoire made for beginners. By carrying it with them in quests, {{player}} will be able to cast simple but useful spells. They need this! Only {{count}} lollipops.
Beginners' Grimoire.sorceressPost: Thanks for buying! {{player}} will be able to cast three spells with this grimoire. Good luck!
Beginners' Grimoire.forgePost: I got this from a mage in training who ended up failing mage school. I provided them with weapons to become a knight.
Beginners' Grimoire.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test and found the book! I taught {{player}} how to read the language of the sorcerers, so they might have a use for this.
Beginners' Grimoire.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I took 100 candies and a chocolate bar. Deep in the basement of the castle I found this grimoire. I know it will be very useful to {{player}}.

Advanced Grimoire.merchantPre: I found this book in the attic the other day. I don't know how to read the language, but it looks useful, so I can send it to {{player}} for {{count}} candies.
Advanced Grimoire.sorceressPre: This is an advanced grimoire. By carrying it with them in quests, {{player}} will be able to cast two advanced spells. I wrote it myself, which wasn't easy. {{count}} lollipops is a fair price.
Advanced Grimoire.sorceressPost: Thanks for buying! {{player}} will be able to cast two spells with this grimoire. Use them wisely!
Advanced Grimoire.forgePost: I got this from a wizard who wanted to change jobs. I provided them with weapons to become a knight.
Advanced Grimoire.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test and found the book! I taught {{player}} how to read the language of the sorcerers, so they might have a use for this.
Advanced Grimoire.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I took 100 candies and a chocolate bar. Deep in the basement of the castle I found this grimoire. I know it will be very useful to {{player}}.

Sorceress' Cauldron.merchantPre: This is a massive pot that I bought the other day to cook noodle soup, but it turns out I'm actually really bad at cooking.
Sorceress' Cauldron.sorceressPre: This is my cauldron. It allows me to brew magic potions. I could sell it to someone who needs it, but it's very precious... it will cost you {{count}} lollipops.
Sorceress' Cauldron.sorceressPost: Thanks a lot! I included a brewing manual. It's going to be useful.
Sorceress' Cauldron.forgePost: I forged this cauldron for a sorceress that came by two weeks back, but it turns out they couldn't pay!
Sorceress' Cauldron.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! I promised {{player}} that I'd send them a cauldron if you could pass the test, so I guess it's time to uphold my end of the deal.
Sorceress' Cauldron.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar. I've asked my brother to help {{player}} in their quest. I know he will be very helpful! Sorry? Brother? Yes, we were made in the same factory!

Sorceress' Hat.merchantPre: This is a funny shaped hat. It doesn't compare to mine. That's why {{player}} can have it. Only {{count}} candies!
Sorceress' Hat.sorceressPre: I have a nice hat, indeed! But I really can't sell it. It is waaaay too precious. Really, I can't. Don't insist. No. No no no I shouldn't do that. Oh, well, I'll trade it, but for {{count}} lollipops.
Sorceress' Hat.sorceressPost: I don't have a hat any more. I hope {{player}} finds it useful.
Sorceress' Hat.forgePost: This funny hat flew in the other day and came to rest on the extraction hood over there.
Sorceress' Hat.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! My friend the sorceress asked me to pass this to {{player}} if you could solve the test, so I'll do that now.
Sorceress' Hat.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar, and I made... wait, what's happening? Why is there a flying hat inside me??? *pbtthhh* I'm sorry, but could you take this and hand it to {{player}}?

Octopus King Crown.sorceressPre: This crown is said to have once belonged to the Octopus King. By wearing this crown, the wearer is imbued with the gift of confidence.
Octopus King Crown.merchantPre: When I went fishing a few months ago, I found an octopus wearing this crown. It doesn't compare to my hat, though!
Octopus King Crown.forgePost: I tried to melt this crown to make tools out of it, but it just wouldn't melt!
Octopus King Crown.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! The Octopus King gave me this crown when I met him last. I'm sure he won't mind if I pass it on to {{player}}.
Octopus King Crown.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar, and I made... a beautiful crown! This crown should empower the wearer with confidence! Hmm? What? Yes, confidence is important!

Monkey Wizard Staff.merchantPre: Could you take this off me? I don't really want to burn down my shop but no one will take it!
Monkey Wizard Staff.sorceressPre: Be careful with this one. When {{player}} carries this in a quest, it will send magical purple balls to their enemies. Only {{count}} lollipops!
Monkey Wizard Staff.sorceressPost: Thanks for buying! Remind them it won't do anything until they equip it in the Inventory screen!
Monkey Wizard Staff.forgePost: These purple balls keep emanating from the tip of the staff, so be careful with it!
Monkey Wizard Staff.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! My brother defeated one of those naked monkey wizards the other day and gave this to me. {{player}} can have it.
Monkey Wizard Staff.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I took 100 candies and a chocolate bar and I made... this staff! It will keep shooting fireballs at nearby enemies!

Heart Plug.merchantPre: I don't know what this does, but when I hold it, I always feel more energetic. I don't need it though, because I don't want to get used to it. Maybe you know someone who would have a use for it?
Heart Plug.sorceressPre: I built this device to let {{player}} live longer! It took a lot of effort to get the spider legs and the Heart Liquor to make this! And it's only {{count}} lollipops - what a deal!
Heart Plug.sorceressPost: Heart Liquor is very rare, you know. {{player}} should be glad that I was selling it for super cheap!
Heart Plug.forgePost: I kind of wanted to keep this, but I figured it would be more important that {{player}} took it.
Heart Plug.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test and found {{player}}'s Heart Plug! This will be very useful to them, I assure you.
Heart Plug.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar, and I made... some heart liquor! I put it in this container and sent it to {{player}}. I know it will be useful for them!

Pogo Stick.merchantPre: I've had this Pogo Stick since I was a wee little child. I don't use it any more, so if you someone who needs it, you can have it... for {{count}} candies of course!
Pogo Stick.sorceressPre: Someone gave me this Pogo Stick many years ago. I'm not sure why though, because my magic broom can keep me in the air for longer!
Pogo Stick.sorceressPost: Oh, make sure you maintain it! These can be pretty dangerous if they aren't maintained!
Pogo Stick.forgePost: This pogo stick is an amalgamation of my blood, sweat and tears. I hope it is useful!
Pogo Stick.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! For your reward, I've sent this Pogo Stick to {{player}}. It should allow them to gain some height.
Pogo Stick.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar. This was left in the doorway the other day, do you think you could return it to {{player}} for me?

P Stone.merchantPre: I found this rock outside the other day. It caught my eye because of how the letter P seems to be carved inside.
P Stone.sorceressPre: This stone with a P shape carved into it is said to have the ability to summon the Magical Talking Candy. Not much is known about how this is done, but {{player}} might find it helpful.
P Stone.sorceressPost: Thanks! Oh, I just remembered a riddle that might help: "In the tower, must you cower; Play the stones to reveal the throne... s?" - If you can decipher this riddle, let me know!
P Stone.forgePost: I'm not sure what this does, but I hope it will be of use.
P Stone.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test and found {{player}}'s stone. It's very precious, but is only useful if they have three other stones like this one. Good luck!
P Stone.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar, and I made... something very special for {{player}}! A cyclops taught me how to make this. I hope they enjoy it!

L Stone.merchantPre: I found this rock outside the other day. It caught my eye because of how the letter L seems to be carved inside.
L Stone.sorceressPre: This stone with a L shape carved into it is said to have the ability to summon the Magical Talking Candy. Not much is known about how this is done, but {{player}} might find it helpful.
L Stone.sorceressPost: Thanks! Oh, I just remembered a riddle that might help: "In the tower, must you cower; Play the stones to reveal the throne... s?" - If you can decipher this riddle, let me know!
L Stone.forgePost: I'm not sure what this does, but I hope it will be of use.
L Stone.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test and found {{player}}'s stone. It's very precious, but is only useful if they have three other stones like this one. Good luck!
L Stone.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar, and I made... something very special for {{player}}! A cyclops taught me how to make this. I hope they enjoy it!

A Stone.merchantPre: I found this rock outside the other day. It caught my eye because of how the letter A seems to be carved inside.
A Stone.sorceressPre: This stone with an A shape carved into it is said to have the ability to summon the Magical Talking Candy. Not much is known about how this is done, but {{player}} might find it helpful.
A Stone.sorceressPost: Thanks! Oh, I just remembered a riddle that might help: "In the tower, must you cower; Play the stones to reveal the throne... s?" - If you can decipher this riddle, let me know!
A Stone.forgePost: I'm not sure what this does, but I hope it will be of use.
A Stone.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test and found {{player}}'s stone. It's very precious, but is only useful if they have three other stones like this one. Good luck!
A Stone.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar, and I made... something very special for {{player}}! A cyclops taught me how to make this. I hope they enjoy it!

Y Stone.merchantPre: I found this rock outside the other day. It caught my eye because of how the letter Y seems to be carved inside.
Y Stone.sorceressPre: This stone with a Y shape carved into it is said to have the ability to summon the Magical Talking Candy. Not much is known about how this is done, but {{player}} might find it helpful.
Y Stone.sorceressPost: Thanks! Oh, I just remembered a riddle that might help: "In the tower, must you cower; Play the stones to reveal the throne... s?" - If you can decipher this riddle, let me know!
Y Stone.forgePost: I'm not sure what this does, but I hope it will be of use.
Y Stone.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test and found {{player}}'s stone. It's very precious, but is only useful if they have three other stones like this one. Good luck!
Y Stone.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar, and I made... something very special for {{player}}! A cyclops taught me how to make this. I hope they enjoy it!

Wooden Sword.forgePost: Thanks for buying! This wooden sword is quite weak, but it's a start.
Wooden Sword.merchantPre: This is a wooden sword. {{player}} will need it if they are to get very far!
Wooden Sword.sorceressPre: That's {{player}}'s wooden sword. A little weak, if you ask me.
Wooden Sword.sorceressPost: Honestly, I think you should have saved your lollipops for something more... substantial.

Iron Axe.forgePost: I hope they'll like this iron axe. I have just sharpened it for them!
Iron Axe.merchantPre: This is an axe made of iron. Perfect for chopping down trees and camels!
Iron Axe.sorceressPre: That's {{player}}'s iron axe. It's really heavy and unwieldy to use.
Iron Axe.sorceressPost: Honestly, I think you should have saved your lollipops for something less... heavy.

Polished Silver Sword.merchantPre: This is a sharp sword. Perfect for killing enemies.
Polished Silver Sword.sorceressPre: This is a sharp sword. It's a nice weapon to have, but unfortunately it has no magic abilities.
Polished Silver Sword.sorceressPost: I'm not sure why you'd want a weapon without magical abilities.
Polished Silver Sword.forgePost: It took me a lot of time to create this sword. I assure you that it's worth its price.

Lightweight Body Armour.merchantPre: This is some armour. Whoever equips it will take a little less damage. Only {{count}} candies!
Lightweight Body Armour.sorceressPre: This metal thing? You want to buy this???
Lightweight Body Armour.sorceressPost: Well, as long as I get lollipops for it I guess...
Lightweight Body Armour.forgePost: This body armour will offer {{player}} a protection against their enemies.

Scythe.merchantPre: This scythe is mighty sharp. I bet it could cut more than grass!
Scythe.forgePost: It took me several months to make this scythe. It's a real piece of art. This is probably the fastest weapon {{player}} will ever be able to use. Good luck!
Scythe.sorceressPre: I got this from a student who gave up farming. I have no use for it though, because it won't help my lollipop farm.
Scythe.sorceressPost: Actually, the guy who gave up farming didn't want to give it up: they failed farmer's school!

Red Enchanted Gloves.merchantPre: One day, I found these gloves scurrying along the floor. I think a spider was carrying it or something. When it returned, it had this weird red glow to it.
Red Enchanted Gloves.sorceressPre: These gloves will randomly cast small fireballs everywhere while the wearer is in a quest. {{count}} lollipops - what a steal!
Red Enchanted Gloves.sorceressPost: I can almost guarantee that these gloves were worth their money.
Red Enchanted Gloves.forgePost: I lost these gloves in the desert the other day. When I found them and put them on, fireballs were coming out! Definitely useful.

Pink Enchanted Gloves.merchantPre: One day, I found these gloves scurrying along the floor. I think an ant was carrying it or something. When it returned, it had this weird pink glow to it.
Pink Enchanted Gloves.sorceressPre: These gloves will constantly heal the wearer while they are in quests. Only {{count}} lollipops! You need this!
Pink Enchanted Gloves.sorceressPost: I can almost guarantee that these gloves were worth their money.
Pink Enchanted Gloves.forgePost: I accidentally dropped a chocolate bar in the wishing well while I was wearing these the other day, and they turned pink!

Summoning Tribal Spear.merchantPre: I have a weird feeling about this thing. Every time I hold it I hear sounds of people falling on the grass outside. But when I go check it out, there's never anyone out there.
Summoning Tribal Spear.sorceressPre: This spear was blessed with the ability to spawn tribal warriors, who will greatly help the wielder in their quests!
Summoning Tribal Spear.sorceressPost: Whatever you do though, don't jump into the sea with this. I mean it!
Summoning Tribal Spear.forgePost: I make spears like this, but this one I made this with some special iron. Just for {{player}}!

Enchanted Monkey Wizard Staff.merchantPre: Could you take this off me? I don't really want to burn down my shop but no one will take it!
Enchanted Monkey Wizard Staff.sorceressPre: Be careful with this one. When {{player}} carries this in a quest, it will send lots of magical purple balls to their enemies. Only {{count}} lollipops! Great deal!
Enchanted Monkey Wizard Staff.sorceressPost: Thanks for buying! Remind them it won't do anything until they equip it in the Inventory screen!
Enchanted Monkey Wizard Staff.forgePost: These purple balls keep emanating from the tip of the staff, so be careful with it!
Enchanted Monkey Wizard Staff.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! My brother found this near the wishing well the other day. {{player}} can have it.

Enchanted Knight Body Armour.merchantPre: This is really heavy armour! It's also glowing! That must mean something!
Enchanted Knight Body Armour.sorceressPre: When I was training a young sorceress, I asked her to enchant an object and make it useful. This is what she ended up enchanting - a useless hunk of metal! I couldn't believe it!
Enchanted Knight Body Armour.sorceressPost: Needless to say, she did NOT pass sorcery school. Good riddance.
Enchanted Knight Body Armour.forgePost: This is some really heavy armour, and it's enchanted too! {{player}} got that for a great price!

Octopus King Crown with Jaspers.merchantPre: When I went fishing a few months ago, I found an octopus wearing this crown. It doesn't compare to my hat, though!
Octopus King Crown with Jaspers.sorceressPre: This crown is said to have once belonged to the Octopus King. I added some red jaspers to it, which makes it throw fireballs everywhere in quests!
Octopus King Crown with Jaspers.sorceressPost: Did I forget to mention that you are not harmed by your own fireballs? That's a good tip, so keep that in mind!
Octopus King Crown with Jaspers.forgePost: I tried to melt this crown to make tools out of it, but it just wouldn't melt!

Octopus King Crown with Obsidian.merchantPre: When I went fishing a few months ago, I found an octopus wearing this crown. It doesn't compare to my hat, though!
Octopus King Crown with Obsidian.forgePost: I tried to melt this crown to make tools out of it, but it just wouldn't melt!
Octopus King Crown with Obsidian.sorceressPre: This crown is said to have once belonged to the Octopus King. I added obsidian to make it look nice! During a quest, it has a special ability too!
Octopus King Crown with Obsidian.sorceressPost: Do not be alarmed while wearing this crown. You will receive a lot of help!

Giant Spoon of Doom.merchantPre: I found this absolutely gigantic metal spoon dug into the ground outside. Surprisingly, it's not that heavy.
Giant Spoon of Doom.sorceressPre: You could almost drink the ocean outside with this spoon. It's so refined! So luxurious! You'll never drink from a spoon like this ever again! It's absolutely gleaming with magic!
Giant Spoon of Doom.sorceressPost: I implore you to disregard what I said before. Drinking the entire ocean is probably not a good idea. It's saltwater after all!
Giant Spoon of Doom.forgePost: One day I was feeling really angry, so I whacked this sheet of metal until it looked like this. Huh? I'm sure it'll be useful for something!
Giant Spoon of Doom.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! I used to know a boy named Jack, and he asked me to remove this from his garden. Supposedly, it fell from the sky.
Giant Spoon of Doom.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I took 100 candies and a chocolate bar. A pot used to live next to me, until its nonstick coating wore off. They left the ladle though, here, {{player}} can have it.

Tribal Spear.merchantPre: This is a spear. Great for fishing!
Tribal Spear.sorceressPre: This is a basic spear. Kinda heavy. Not very special.
Tribal Spear.sorceressPost: I'm honestly surprised you thought that was worth the lollipops.
Tribal Spear.forgePost: This spear is one of my finest creations. I hope they'll like it!
Tribal Spear.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test and found {{player}}'s spear! It's really useful for stabbing enemies.
Tribal Spear.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar, and I made... a spear! Don't ask me how, the recipe is secret! But it's really useful for stabbing enemies!

Giant Spoon.merchantPre: I found this absolutely gigantic spoon dug into the ground outside. Surprisingly, it's not that heavy.
Giant Spoon.sorceressPre: You could almost drink the ocean outside with this spoon. Just take a few sips and you'd be done!
Giant Spoon.sorceressPost: I implore you to disregard what I said before. Drinking the entire ocean is probably not a good idea. It's saltwater after all!
Giant Spoon.forgePost: One of my trainees tried to make a bathtub, but made this instead. Needless to say, they were not cut out for woodwork.
Giant Spoon.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! I used to know a boy named Jack, and he asked me to remove this from his garden. Supposedly, it fell from the sky.
Giant Spoon.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I took 100 candies and a chocolate bar. You know, I was once a pizza oven, but ever since the spider next door demanded pineapples, I never made any more. Here, {{player}} can have the pizza spoon.

Desert Fortress Key.merchantPre: This golden key probably opens something. That's what keys do, right?
Desert Fortress Key.sorceressPre: This key opens the ancient fortress near the desert in {{player}}'s world. What's inside? That's for me to know, and for you to find out!
Desert Fortress Key.sorceressPost: Okay, I'll admit I lied about knowing what's inside. Come back and tell me all about it!
Desert Fortress Key.forgePost: Someone asked me to clone their key, but they ended up not being able to pay for it. {{player}} can have this.
Desert Fortress Key.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! I have sent {{player}} the key to the ancient fortress near the desert in their world.
Desert Fortress Key.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar, and I made... a key! What for, you ask? Well, it's for the ancient fortress in {{player}}'s world!

Knight Body Armour.merchantPre: This is really heavy armour. I would say it's super effective! Only {{count}} candies for ultimate protection!
Knight Body Armour.sorceressPre: This metal cage was worn by a poor knight who tried to cross the bridge, but was defeated by the troll.
Knight Body Armour.sorceressPost: Considering the knight didn't get past the bridge I'm not sure how useful this will be.
Knight Body Armour.forgePost: This body armour is made with 70% more metal, ensuring maximum protection!
Knight Body Armour.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! I had some heavy armour in my basement, and I've given it to {{player}}. They will find it very useful indeed.
Knight Body Armour.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar. I went to the secret armoury and found this - {{player}} can have it!

Xinopherydon Claw.merchantPre: I've never seen a tooth as big as this one. I wonder what creature it came from.
Xinopherydon Claw.sorceressPre: This is a claw of a xinopherydon. This might be the last one up for sale anywhere! These creatures are extinct, you know. And I'm only asking for {{count}} lollipops too! You can't get much better than that!
Xinopherydon Claw.sorceressPost: You know, I feel a little bad for the xinopherydons of the world. They used to be plentiful, but hunting brought them to extinction.
Xinopherydon Claw.forgePost: This claw will double the damage of the weapon {{player}} is using. I have just sharpened it too!
Xinopherydon Claw.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! I have a source of sustainable and responsibly obtained xinopherydon claws, so as a reward, {{player}} can have one. I trust it will be very useful.
Xinopherydon Claw.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I took 100 candies and a chocolate bar! I found a claw in the chocolate bar you gave me, so I used the candies to open a portal to {{player}}'s world and I gave them the claw!

Unicorn Horn.sorceressPre: This is the horn of a common unicorn. Whoever holds it will be looked after by the unicorn who grew it. And by that, I mean that the unicorn will heal their wounds constantly during quests. Only {{count}} lollipops!
Unicorn Horn.merchantPre: This looks like a musical instrument of some description, but I'm not exactly sure. It seems to be made of bone.
Unicorn Horn.sorceressPost: Fun fact: unicorns can regrow their horn, and it doesn't hurt when you take it! So if you see a unicorn, ask nicely if you can have its horn and it might be willing to give it to you!
Unicorn Horn.forgePost: Thanks for buying! The unicorn that produced this horn will watch over {{player}}, accelerating the healing of their wounds!
Unicorn Horn.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test! I asked a unicorn very nicely if I could have its horn yesterday, and it said yes! As a reward for passing the test, {{player}} can have this horn.
Unicorn Horn.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I took 100 candies and a chocolate bar. A long time ago, a unicorn came in and asked me to bake something, just like you did! As payment, it left me its horn. Here, {{player}} can have it!

Rocket Boots.merchantPre: These boots seem to have some sort of propulsion system built in. I can see them being very useful, if you can figure out how they work. I haven't managed to get them working.
Rocket Boots.sorceressPre: These boots with a propulsion system will let the wearer reach great heights, as long as they have a pogo stick. Only {{count}} lollipops!
Rocket Boots.sorceressPost: Why do you need a pogo stick to activate the propulsion system? Well, as you can see, the oscillating quantum crystal needs to vibrate at exactly the right frequency, and only a pogo stick can generate the required flux to resonate... Sorry, did I lose you?
Rocket Boots.forgePost: I added a special propulsion system to these boots just for {{player}}! They will be very useful!
Rocket Boots.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test and found the boots. Once {{player}} has both these boots and a pogo stick, they will be able to reach unrivaled heights. Probably even higher than this lighthouse.

Heart Pendant.merchantPre: This gem is really beautiful. Only {{count}} candies!
Heart Pendant.sorceressPre: When {{player}} wears this pendant around their neck, they will be able to sustain more damage. Protection doesn't usually come this cheap - only {{count}} lollipops!
Heart Pendant.sorceressPost: If I were {{player}}, I'd wear this all the time! It's always better safe than sorry!
Heart Pendant.forgePost: This gem came out of some iron I was melting down the other day. I added a chain so {{player}} can wear it like a necklace!
Heart Pendant.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test and found the pendant! This pendant will increase {{player}}'s HP while they are wearing it. It's very precious, so tell them to take care of it!
Heart Pendant.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar, and I made... this necklace! I hope {{player}} likes it!

Black Magic Grimoire.merchantPre: I found this book under my pillow the other day. I don't know how it got there. Is there a "book fairy" I don't know about? It looks useful, so I can send it to {{player}} for {{count}} candies.

Black Magic Grimoire.sorceressPost: Don't tell anyone about this deal, understood? I could get in big trouble!
Black Magic Grimoire.forgePost: I beat a magician at his own game a few years ago, and this was my reward. I don't find myself needing to to summon demons though. Who does that?
Black Magic Grimoire.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test and found the book! I taught {{player}} how to read the language of the sorcerers, so they might have a use for this.
Black Magic Grimoire.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I took 100 candies and a chocolate bar. Deep in the basement of the castle I found this grimoire. I know it will be very useful to {{player}}.

4 Chocolate Bars.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar, and I converted the candies into 3 more chocolate bars and gave them to {{player}}!

Locked Candy Box.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar. Here, I want {{player}} to have this - a box someone left in this room many years ago. To this day, I have never managed to discover what's inside.

Obsidian Wall Spell.sorceressPre: When {{player}} punches this tablet, a giant obsidian wall will appear in front of them, stopping enemies from passing!
Obsidian Wall Spell.sorceressPost: If {{player}} needs to get past, they can simply smash the wall.
Obsidian Wall Spell.forgePost: I found this stone tablet with a magic spell in my office. I think {{player}} can have it.
Obsidian Wall Spell.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test and found the spell! This spell will cause a wall to be erected in front of {{player}}. Good luck with the rest of your adventure!
Obsidian Wall Spell.hoven: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar. Tell you what, why don't I write this recipe down and give it to you? You might know someone who might find it useful!

Black Demons Spell.merchantPre: This tablet seems to have some writing on it, but I can't interpret it.

Black Demons Spell.sorceressPost: Be careful, the demons will also attack {{player}}!

Font Trap.merchantPre: When I pinch this object, the entire world seems to blur for me. It's not very nice! Please take this away from me!
Font Trap.sorceressPre: I was cursed with possession of this artifact by a demon from Elysium. As long as it's in my posession, the entire world seems to be blurry. I beg you, please take it away from me!
Font Trap.forgePost: Take this artifact and never come back with it.
Font Trap.cyclops: Thank goodness you finished that quickly. I couldn't wait to be rid of this.
Font Trap.hoven: Yay! Thank you SO MUCH! I can see clearly now!
